notes: ἀφ' οὗ ἄν → *When once* is split as ἀφ' οὗ → *When* (one aligned unit under rule 45's test) and ἄν → *once*, keeping rule 50's requirement that ἄν be aligned; joining all three on *When once* is the competing reading.
οἰκοδεσπότης → *master of the house* heads on *master*, the compound's core being δεσπότης (rule 66).
*knock at* keeps the preposition inside the verb under rule 106's accusative arm, τὴν θύραν being accusative.
